purpose: Complete the independent quadrature, numerical-dissipation and adjacent continuum-parameter controls in the original robustness protocol.
candidate: Fixed refined-scri exponential grid b16, width7, KO8, PCHIP stage rays and dense exits; no projections.
source_rule: Dispatch from the completed main candidate matrix-source/run_telegraph_matrix.py and its frozen libraries, so all numerical dependencies match the main run. Keep at most two evolution workers.
quadrature: At N2049 compare quadrature7 baseline with9 and11 through t10. Report all full-time field, constraint, gradient, ray and finite-mass differences. Require changes to be below10% of the matching main N2049-to4097 spatial differences; treat zero denominators explicitly. This tests shift quadrature, not spatial-stencil width.
KO: At fixed amplitude .25 and .75 run three related grids through t10. Each amplitude must retain the original convergence, magnitude, boundary and positivity gates. Compare fine-grid differences with baseline spatial errors; dissipation changes are numerical, not distinct continuum physics.
continuum_parameters: At fixed kappa .0045 and .0055 with tau .02, and tau .018 and .022 with kappa .005, run three grids each through t10. Each is a distinct coordinate gauge and need not have identical lapse profiles. Require original full-domain convergence, front, constraint, boundary and positivity gates separately. Parameters are fixed across resolution; no h-dependent tuning.
temporal: The main N2049 dt/dt2/dt4 study remains mandatory. Additional time refinement is required if any control reveals new sharp fronts, stage-CFL pressure, or uncertainty about whether its observed spatial differences dominate time error.
dispatch_gate: Prepared only. Inspect the full main three-grid and time-control results before dispatch; failures must be repaired or documented rather than bypassed.
acceptance: No relaxation of telegraph-protocol-v1.json thresholds. These controls remain unrun and cannot support completion.
